transformation: Draft from the opt-in upstream recorder: prompts, long text, URLs and IDs are placeholders; query values, headers outside the replay set and media bytes are not stored. The recorded credits_consumed amount with two zero decimals is written as the equal integer: the privacy scan reads a two-part decimal as the inet_aton IPv4 shorthand, an address in the private 10/8 range, and would hold the policy's allowed value.
